title: Empty State Copy
content: Create effective empty state messaging. Structure: illustration/icon, headline, description, action button. Headline: clear statement of empty state ("No projects yet"). Description: explain value and next step. Action CTA: primary button to create/add first item. Illustration: friendly, relevant illustration or icon. Tone: encouraging, not negative. Variants: first-time vs. filtered/searched empty. Search empty: "No results" with suggestions. Error empty: differentiate from normal empty. Secondary actions: alternative actions or help links. Examples: show example data option.

variants.simple: Write engaging copy for empty states with clear actions.

variants.advanced: Create effective empty state messaging system for different scenarios. Core structure: illustration or icon (centered, not too large), headline (text-xl font-semibold), description (text-gray-500 max-w-md), primary action button (Create, Add, Get Started). Messaging principles: focus on positive outcome not absence, explain value user will get, clear single action to resolve. Tone: encouraging and helpful, not apologetic or negative, match brand voice. Scenario variations: first-time empty (welcome, explain value, encourage first action), search/filter empty (no results found, suggest adjustments), error-caused empty (explain issue, provide recovery action). First-time copy example: headline "Start your first project", description "Projects help you organize your work and collaborate with your team.", button "Create Project". Search empty copy: headline "No results for query", description "Try adjusting your search or filters.", actions: clear filters button, search tips link. Illustration guidance: friendly, relevant to feature, consistent style, not too prominent (should support, not dominate). Icon alternative: large icon (h-12 w-12 text-gray-400) when illustration not available. Secondary actions: help link, documentation, example templates. Demo/example data: "Load example data" option to show how feature works. Permissions empty: when user lacks access, explain and provide request access flow. Component API: <EmptyState icon={Folder} title="..." description="..." action={{label, onClick}} secondaryAction={{label, href}} />.
